title: 安装栅栏
summary: 给定平面上的树坐标，返回位于能包围所有树的最短栅栏边界上的全部树。
insight: Andrew 单调链按坐标排序构造上下凸壳；只弹出严格右转点即可保留边界共线点，最后去重排序。
pitfalls: 边界线段上的共线点也必须返回
叉积应使用长整数避免溢出
上下壳端点会重复，需要去重

solutions.title: 保留共线点的单调链凸包
solutions.idea: 排序后分别构造下壳和上壳，并用严格右转判定移除内部点。
steps: 按 x、y 排序所有点
正向与反向扫描，叉积小于零时弹栈
合并两壳去重并按坐标排序返回

code.java: class Solution { public int[][] outerTrees(int[][] trees){Arrays.sort(trees,(a,b)->a[0]!=b[0]?Integer.compare(a[0],b[0]):Integer.compare(a[1],b[1]));List<int[]> lower=new ArrayList<>(),upper=new ArrayList<>();for(int[] point:trees){while(lower.size()>=2&&cross(lower.get(lower.size()-2),lower.get(lower.size()-1),point)<0)lower.remove(lower.size()-1);lower.add(point);}for(int i=trees.length-1;i>=0;i--){int[] point=trees[i];while(upper.size()>=2&&cross(upper.get(upper.size()-2),upper.get(upper.size()-1),point)<0)upper.remove(upper.size()-1);upper.add(point);}TreeSet<int[]> boundary=new TreeSet<>((a,b)->a[0]!=b[0]?Integer.compare(a[0],b[0]):Integer.compare(a[1],b[1]));boundary.addAll(lower);boundary.addAll(upper);return boundary.toArray(new int[boundary.size()][]);}private long cross(int[] a,int[] b,int[] c){return(long)(b[0]-a[0])*(c[1]-a[1])-(long)(b[1]-a[1])*(c[0]-a[0]);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun outerTrees(trees:Array<IntArray>):Array<IntArray>{val points=trees.sortedWith(compareBy<IntArray>{it[0]}.thenBy{it[1]});val lower=mutableListOf<IntArray>();val upper=mutableListOf<IntArray>();for(point in points){while(lower.size>=2&&cross(lower[lower.size-2],lower.last(),point)<0)lower.removeAt(lower.lastIndex);lower.add(point)};for(index in points.indices.reversed()){val point=points[index];while(upper.size>=2&&cross(upper[upper.size-2],upper.last(),point)<0)upper.removeAt(upper.lastIndex);upper.add(point)};val boundary=java.util.TreeSet<Pair<Int,Int>>(compareBy<Pair<Int,Int>>{it.first}.thenBy{it.second});for(point in lower+upper)boundary.add(point[0] to point[1]);return boundary.map{intArrayOf(it.first,it.second)}.toTypedArray()};private fun cross(a:IntArray,b:IntArray,c:IntArray):Long=(b[0]-a[0]).toLong()*(c[1]-a[1])-(b[1]-a[1]).toLong()*(c[0]-a[0]) }
code.cpp: class Solution { long long cross(const vector<int>& a,const vector<int>& b,const vector<int>& c){return 1LL*(b[0]-a[0])*(c[1]-a[1])-1LL*(b[1]-a[1])*(c[0]-a[0]);}public:vector<vector<int>> outerTrees(vector<vector<int>>& trees){sort(trees.begin(),trees.end());vector<vector<int>> lower,upper;for(auto& point:trees){while(lower.size()>=2&&cross(lower[lower.size()-2],lower.back(),point)<0)lower.pop_back();lower.push_back(point);}for(int i=trees.size()-1;i>=0;--i){auto& point=trees[i];while(upper.size()>=2&&cross(upper[upper.size()-2],upper.back(),point)<0)upper.pop_back();upper.push_back(point);}set<pair<int,int>> boundary;for(auto& point:lower)boundary.insert({point[0],point[1]});for(auto& point:upper)boundary.insert({point[0],point[1]});vector<vector<int>> result;for(auto [x,y]:boundary)result.push_back({x,y});return result;} };
